a penalty of Rs. 3,000/- per day shall be imposed and deducted from the m onthly bill. 5. 5 . The vehicle provided should comply with the laws in force in India. 6. 6 . If the tenderer gives wrong information deliberately to meet conditions f or acceptance of the tender, the bid is liable for rejection. The original copy of the earnest money deposit should be sent t o this office on or before the time of closing of the uploading of the Bids. Th e original of the EMD can be sent by Speed Post or Registered Post. It can also be handed over in person. In the event of non-receipt of the EMD befo re the closing of the uploading of the Bids, the bid shall not be opened. Bid ders, who are eligible to be exempted from depositing EMD according to R ule-170 of GFRs, 2017, should upload documentary proof thereof along wit h a technical bid online through GeM Portal. 8. 8 . The contractor shall not deploy any driver who has not completed eighte en years of age. The contractor shall comply with all the statutory provisio ns as laid down under various Labour Laws/Acts/Rules in force from time to time at his own cost. In case of violation of any such statutory provisions u nder Labour Laws or any other law applicable by the Contractor, there will not be any liability on the Department. 9. 9 . The driver shall be well versed with routes and locations in Mumbai. 1010. . The Department will be under no legal obligation to provide employment to any of the personnel of the contractor during the period of the agreeme nt and after the expiry of the agreement period and the Department recog nizes no employer-employee relationship between the Department and the personnel deployed by the contractor/agency. 1111. . Any person who is in Government service or an employee of this Depart ment should not be made partners to the contract by the contractor directl y or indirectly in any manner whatsoever. 1212. . The contractor shall indemnify the Department against all other damage s/charges for which the Government/Department may be held liable or pay on account of the negligence of the contractor or his staff or any person un der his control whether in respect of accident/injury to the person or dama ges to the property of any member of the public or any person or in executi ng the work or otherwise and against all claims and demand thereof. The D epartment shall not be responsible financially or otherwise for any injury to the driver or person deployed by the contractor during the course of perfor ming the duties. 1313. . The Department reserves the right to terminate the contract without assi gning any reason. 1414. . The vehicles should conform to the Pollution norms prescribed, if any, by the Transport Department of Government India. 1515. . The contractor shall provide vehicles as per the requirement of the Depa rtment including public holidays, Saturdays and Sundays. No extra payme nt shall be made except for extra kilometres more than the monthly limit. 1616. . The vehicle and Driver shall remain available all the time as per Duty Ros ter and shall not leave place of duty without prior permission. 1717. . Operation and function of vehicles and Drivers shall be governed by Mot or Vehicles Act/Motor Vehicles Rules and these shall be the responsibility o

f the contractor. 1818. . The vehicle should be kept in clean and tidy condition, free of pests and odour and should be equipped with a first aid box, fire extinguishers, and o ther basic amenities. The mileage as well as time shall be calculated from the initial pick -up point of the day. The closing time and mileage shall be t he last destination where the official journey ends for the day. No mileage shall be allowed to drivers for lunch/breakfast or for filling fuel for charging etc. 1919. . Vehicles provided should be in very good condition and road worthy. If th e vehicle is not of the specified model i.e. older than the 2024 year model, the tender is liable to be rejected. 2020. . Rate should be quoted for hiring on a monthly basis for 2500 kilometres per month for 360 hrs including Saturday, Sunday and Holidays. 2121. . In case, if in a month vehicle run below 2500 kilometres. The remaining kilometres restricted to 250 km of the said month would be carried forward to the following months cumulatively. 2222. . The payment towards hiring of the vehicle will be made on the basis of lo g book and log sheet maintained by the driver which would be duly approv ed by the officer utilizing the vehicles. 2323. . This office reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vehicles during the period of the contract as per the requirement of the offi ce. 2424. . The Department will deduct Income tax at source under Section 194-C of the Income Tax Act from the contract or at the prevailing rates of such su m as income tax on the income comprised therein. 2525. . A pre-bid meeting may be scheduled acquaint the vendors with the requi rement of the office. It is mandatory for bidders/vendors to attend this mee ting. 2626. . In case of any dispute, the decision of the Hon’ble Vice President, GSTAT Maharashtra & Goa shall be final and binding upon both parties. The cause of the dispute, in writing, must be presented to him within 15 days of the o ccurrence of such dispute. For the purpose of adjudication, if occasion aris es, the jurisdiction of the appropriate court shall be that at Delhi. 2727. . The performance of the vendor will be reviewed on quarterly basis and b ased on the satisfactory performance the contract may be extended for on e more year. In case of unsatisfactory performance by the vendor, action will be taken as per GeM policies and the contract may be terminated pre maturely. 28. 2829. . The Bids will undergo Reverse Auction to facilitate competition for the lo west possible prices. .
